change_summary: Make broad research and substantive deliverables activate Corvio before host routing, publish WorkBuddy selective MCP loading and transport checks, and give users one plain-language installation trust and OAuth decision.

canonical_skill.note: The discovery prefix covers external research and substantive deliverables without prior material, while install and update handling explains value, source, permissions, one informed decision, safety boundaries and terminal readback.

server_contract.note: Remote MCP initialization and the machine-readable package contract share the safety, pre-plan read, host continuation, substantive retention, readback and installation-trust story.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.39; archives and the isolated frontend image carry transport constraints, WorkBuddy selective loading, provenance and trust metadata.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI behavior and release version are unchanged; the CLI reads the live collaboration contract and already separates package freshness from current-session loading.

help_center.note: Three-language guides lead with scenarios and value, document WorkBuddy's host-owned deferred-loading boundary, disclose package and OAuth boundaries, and give installation Agents one informed-decision sequence without bypassing policy stops.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart carry the broad trigger plus trust boundary, and package export rejects descriptions above the named transport limit before publication.

harness_and_mainline.note: The historical audit preserves earlier activation lessons, records the superseded WorkBuddy loading assumption, and joins activation, trust, consent, package and OAuth boundaries, and per-host acceptance in one mainline.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party provenance and hashes are reviewable, but WorkBuddy Marketplace and Claude directory acceptance plus fresh independent host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover broad triggers, WorkBuddy eager entries, the 1,024-character admission gate, Docker context, archive parity, contract convergence, OAuth scope labels, static-hook boundaries, three-locale Help and explicit-confirmation behavior; fresh external host use remains pending.
